verdict.rationale: Evidence shows a docs.lithic.com/reference section exists (e.g. postcards reference) but nothing describes runnable/interactive examples (a 'try it' console) and the OpenAPI spec probe returned 404s across all candidate paths, suggesting no exposed interactive spec. The MCP integration lets an AI assistant execute live requests from an editor, but that's a separate agent-tooling feature, not an interactive API reference page.
